title: Goed gelapt Lowieke
overview: Lowieke is the clever accomplice of cooper Jef Van Vaten, who is being pursued by 'the Jew' Schraepmans over an outstanding (falsified) debt. Lowieke is able to help his boss by putting on a travesty act together with Jan Dop, misleading Schraepmans, and conning him out of a sum of money. This money is then handed over to the unsuspecting Van Vaten, allowing him to settle his debt with Schraepmans.
